We are seeking a skilled Frontend Engineer with strong proficiency in ReactJS and a solid understanding of modern frontend development practices. You will play a key role in delivering high-quality, scalable, and user-focused applications, leveraging modern tooling, feature flag frameworks, design systems, and internationalization libraries.

  • Utilize Docker to create and maintain containerized development environments. 
  • Ensure smooth CI/CD processes using Jenkins and GitHub workflows. 
  • Work with product and engineering teams effectively using JIRA and agile practices. 
  • Leverage AI tools like GitHub Copilot to improve productivity and code quality. 
  • Contribute to performance improvements, code reviews, and engineering best practices.

  • ReactJS 
  • Mirage (mocking APIs) 
  • Figma 
  • Docker 
  • i18next 
  • LaunchDarkly 
  • Jenkins 
  • GitHub 
  • JIRA 
  • AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) 

 

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Postman (API testing) 
  • Python (scripting/automation) 
  • MCI

  • Vitest

  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

  • Have experience of tool evaluation and selection

    • Appium
